# Changelog [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#changelog)

## How the VimOS versioning works [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#how-the-vimos-versioning-works)

To provide application developers with the best user experience, allowing automatic bug fixes and easy access to new features while ensuring existing application code continues to work, VimOS offers a versioning system. This system works whether your application installs VimOS via [npm](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/setting-up#npm) or uses a [script tag](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/setting-up#script-tag).

### Bug fixes [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#bug-fixes)

Bug fixes are deployed to the latest version of the VimOS code. Since both the script tag and the npm package dynamically load the VimOS code, your application will automatically receive these fixes without any required changes on your part. Therefore, most bug fixes are not tied to a specific released version and will not be detailed on this page.

### New features [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#new-features)

Some non-breaking new features are added to the current latest version, while others will only be available in future versions. As mentioned above in the bug fixes section, your application will automatically gain access to new features added to the current latest version. However, if a feature includes new TypeScript types, upgrading the npm version will be required to take full advantage of it.

Consequently, the changelog for a specific version may be updated in the future if a new feature is released for it.

### Breaking changes [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#breaking-changes)

Breaking changes will only be released in future versions. This ensures that as long as you don't upgrade the major version of the npm package you are using or change the URL of the script tag, your application will not break.

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.20 (npm) - March 10, 2026 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-20-npm-march-10-2026)

### SDK capability triggers return structured results new featureBreaking change [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#sdk-capability-triggers-return-structured-results)

`autoPopup()` and `pushNotification.show()` now return `Promise<TriggerResult>` instead of void. You get a result with `status` (`sent` \| `blocked` \| `failed`), `type` (e.g. `rate_limited`, `not_allowed_by_manifest`), and `description`. Previously, `pushNotification.show()` threw when not allowed by manifest; it now resolves with `{ status: 'blocked', type: 'not_allowed_by_manifest', ... }`. Prefer checking the returned status over try/catch.

For details, see [Push notification](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#show-push-notification) and [Auto popup](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#auto-popup).

### Hub capabilities: pushNotifications and autoPopup (enabled and reason) new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#hub-capabilities-pushnotifications-and-autopopup-enabled-and-reason)

`vimOS.hub.capabilities` now exposes whether each trigger capability is available and, when disabled, why:

- **`vimOS.hub.capabilities.pushNotifications`**: `{ enabled: boolean; reason?: 'capability_disabled' | 'not_allowed_by_manifest' }` — whether your app can show push notifications. `reason` is present only when `enabled` is false.
- **`vimOS.hub.capabilities.autoPopup`**: same shape as `pushNotifications` — whether your app can call `autoPopup()`.

Use these to avoid calling `pushNotification.show()` or `autoPopup()` when a capability is disabled, or to show in-app messaging (e.g. "Push notifications are disabled for this practice"). For details, see [Hub capabilities](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#hub-capabilities).

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.19 (npm) - February 3, 2026 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-19-npm-february-3-2026)

### Added loincCodes and reason fields to Order new featurebeta [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-loinccodes-and-reason-fields-to-order)

The Order resource now includes a `reason` field in `basicInformation` providing context for why the order was created, and a `loincCodes` array field containing standardized laboratory test codes with code and optional description. These fields are available for LAB, DI, and PROCEDURE order types only (not available for RX orders).

#### Note

TIP

This is available only in relevant EHR systems.

For further details, please refer to the [Orders resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#orders).

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.18 (npm) - December 8, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-18-npm-december-8-2025)

### Added selfPay field to Encounter new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-selfpay-field-to-encounter)

The `basicInformation` object under Encounter now includes a boolean `selfPay` field that indicates whether the encounter has self pay restrictions or not. This field is available in the `encounter.basicInformation.selfPay`.

#### Note

TIP

This is available only in relevant EHR systems.

For further details, please refer to the [Encounter resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#encounter).

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.17 (npm) - November 12, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-17-npm-november-12-2025)

### Added type field to Provider new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-type-field-to-provider)

The Provider type now includes a `type` field that indicates whether the provider is a 'PROVIDER' or 'FACILITY'.

For further details, please refer to the [Provider resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#provider).

### Added new fields to orders and diagnosis code types new featurebeta [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-new-fields-to-orders-and-diagnosis-code-types)

The diagnosis code object now includes an optional `note` field, providing additional context and documentation for each diagnosis. This field is available in the `encounter.assessment.diagnosisCodes` section.

The `basicInformation` object under Orders now includes `notes` and `orderName` fields, providing additional context and identification for each order. These fields are available for orders of type LAB and DI.

#### Note

TIP

This is available only in relevant EHR systems.

- [diagnosis codes documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#diagnosis).
- [orders documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#orders)

### Added diagnosis code notes writeback capability new featurebeta [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-diagnosis-code-notes-writeback-capability)

You can now update notes for diagnosis codes using the new `diagnosisCodesNotes` field in the encounter update capabilities. This allows you to add contextual notes for individual diagnosis codes directly from your application.

#### Note

TIP

This is available only in relevant EHR systems.

For further details, please refer to the [Update encounter diagnosis documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#UpdatableDiagnosis) and [Can update encounter](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#encounter-2)

### Added targetProvider field to Order new featurebeta [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-targetprovider-field-to-order)

The Order resource now includes a `targetProvider` field, allowing access to the provider or facility associated with the order.

#### Note

TIP

Only available when order type is 'DI' and only available in specific EHR systems.

For further details, please refer to the [Orders resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#orders).

### Added order writeback capabilities new featurebeta [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-order-writeback-capabilities)

You can now update order fields using the new `updateOrder` function. This allows you to update order notes and assign a target provider to orders directly from your application.

#### Note

TIP

This is available only in relevant EHR systems.

For further details, please refer to the [Update order documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#order) and [Can update order](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#order-1)

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.16 (npm) - October 20, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-16-npm-october-20-2025)

### Changed SDK file format from UMD to IIFE enhancement [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#changed-sdk-file-format-from-umd-to-iife)

The SDK file format has been updated from UMD (Universal Module Definition) to IIFE (Immediately Invoked Function Expression) for improved performance and compatibility. The file name has also been updated from `vim-sdk.umd.js` to `vim-sdk.js`.

This change provides better browser compatibility and faster loading times while maintaining the same functionality.

**For [npm installations](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/setting-up#npm):** The change will be applied automatically when upgrading to version 2.0.16.

**For [script tag installations](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/setting-up#script-tag):** Update the script source URL from `vim-sdk.umd.js` to `vim-sdk.js`.

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.14 (npm) - September 30, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-14-npm-september-30-2025)

### Added getLabResults and getVitals beta [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-getlabresults-and-getvitals)

You can receive the patient's lab results and vitals for a selected time period by calling `vimSdk.ehr.ehrState.patient.getLabResults()` and `vimSdk.ehr.ehrState.patient.getVitals()` once the patient is in context.

#### Note

TIP

This is available only in relevant EHR systems.

For further details, please refer to the [Get Lab Results documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#patient-lab-results) and [Get Vitals](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#patient-vitals)

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.13 (npm) - September 17, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-13-npm-september-17-2025)

### Added getMedicationList and getAllergyList functions, expand getProblemList response beta [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-getmedicationlist-and-getallergylist-functions-expand-getproblemlist-response)

You can now receive the patient's medication list and allergy list by calling `vimSdk.ehr.ehrState.patient.getMedicationList()` and `vimSdk.ehr.ehrState.patient.getAllergyList()` once the patient is in context. Additionally the response of `vimSdk.ehr.ehrState.patient.getProblemList()` was expanded.

#### Note

TIP

This is available only in relevant EHR systems.

For further details, please refer to the [Get Problem List documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#patient-problem-list) and [Get Medication List documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#patient-medication-list) and [Get Allergy List documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#patient-allergy-list)

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.12 (npm) - September 7, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-12-npm-september-7-2025)

### Introduced Workflow Events and Order Created event new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#introduced-workflow-events-and-order-created-event)

You can now subscribe to discrete EHR user-driven actions via `vimOS.ehr.workflowEvents`. The first available event is `Order Created`, allowing your app to react when an order is created in the EHR, even if an orders view is not currently open in the UI.

For further details, please refer to the [Workflow events documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#workflow-events) and [Order created documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#order-created)

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.11 (npm) - June 16, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-11-npm-june-16-2025)

### Enhanced error handling for authentication failures new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#enhanced-error-handling-for-authentication-failures)

Added `forbidden_error` error type to provide more specific error handling for authentication and authorization failures. When handshake verification fails with an unauthorized error, the SDK now returns a `forbidden_error` instead of a generic `authorization_error`, enabling better error handling in applications.

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.10 (npm) - June 4, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-10-npm-june-4-2025)

### Enhanced ordering provider support enhancement [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#enhanced-ordering-provider-support)

Continued improvements to the ordering provider functionality, providing more comprehensive provider information in order objects. The ordering provider now includes detailed provider data such as provider ID, name, NPI, and specialty information.

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.9 (npm) - June 4, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-9-npm-june-4-2025)

### Added ordering provider to Order type new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-ordering-provider-to-order-type)

Added `orderingProvider` field to the Order type, replacing the previous simplified ordering provider schema with the comprehensive provider schema. This enhancement provides access to detailed provider information including provider ID, first name, last name, NPI, and specialty array.

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.8 (npm) - May 28, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-8-npm-may-28-2025)

### Enhanced encounter type functionality enhancement [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#enhanced-encounter-type-functionality)

Improved encounter type handling and processing, particularly for Practice Fusion EHR systems. This update enhances the reliability and accuracy of encounter type data retrieval and processing.

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.7 (npm) - May 20, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-7-npm-may-20-2025)

### Added encounter capabilities: type, patient instructions, and general notes new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-encounter-capabilities-type-patient-instructions-and-general-notes)

This release enhances the encounter resource with new capabilities for accessing encounter type information, reading patient instructions, and both reading and writing general encounter notes. These additions provide developers with more comprehensive encounter data and note management capabilities within the EHR workflow.

For further details, please refer to the [Encounter resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#encounter) and [Update encounter documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#encounter-1).

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.6 (npm) - May 11, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-6-npm-may-11-2025)

#### Add a microphone badge to your application icon new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#add-a-microphone-badge-to-your-application-icon)

If your application needs to actively access the device's microphone, you can now use the Vim Hub microphone badge function to show a visual microphone indicator on your application icon on the Vim Connect Hub.

For further details, please refer to the [Microphone badge documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#microphone-badge).

#### Added a Claim resource type new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-a-claim-resource-type)

The EHR state now contains a new `claim` resource.

A claim represents a standardized billing object that contains structured information about services rendered to a patient.

For further details, please refer to the [Claim resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#claim).

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.5 (npm) - April 23, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-5-npm-april-23-2025)

#### Added a `putChartRetrievalRequest` function to `Encounter` type new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-a-putchartretrievalrequest-function-to-encounter-type)

You can request the clinical chart of an encounter by calling `putChartRetrievalRequest` function exposed by the SDK under the encounter object. The status of the request will be sent to you via a webhook URL that you provide. Once it's completed, you can download it, and get the clinical chart of the encounter.

For further details, please refer to the [Chart retrieval request documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#chart-retrieval-request).

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.3 (npm) - March 12, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-3-npm-march-12-2025)

#### Added a `facilityNpi` field to `Provider` type new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-a-facilitynpi-field-to-provider-type)

`facilityNpi` field indicates the provider's facility National Provider Identifier (NPI) - a unique 10-digit number assigned to healthcare organizations. This field is available on the provider object which is part of the patient, encounter and referral state.

For further details, please refer to the [Provider resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#provider) and [Encounter resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#encounter) and [Referral resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#referral)

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.1 (npm) - February 23rd, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-1-npm-february-23rd-2025)

#### Added an RX type in `orders`new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-an-rx-type-in-orders)

Added read capabilities for medication data in the Orders workflow. App developers can now access medication data within the Orders EHR workflow, supporting use cases such as medication adherence, coupon benefits, alternative medication recommendations and more.

For further details, please refer to the [Medication data in orders documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#medication) and [Orders resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#orders)

## 2.x.x (sdk) / 2.0.0 (npm) - February 10th, 2025 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_2-x-x-sdk-2-0-0-npm-february-10th-2025)

#### Created a dedicated authentication server enhancement [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#created-a-dedicated-authentication-server)

We've launched a dedicated authentication server at api.getvim.com to improve the availability of third-party authentication.

The following endpoints have moved:

- [https://connect.getvim.com/os-api/v2/oauth/authorize](https://connect.getvim.com/os-api/v2/oauth/authorize) moved to [https://api.getvim.com/v1/oauth/authorize](https://api.getvim.com/v1/oauth/authorize)
- [https://connect.getvim.com/os-api/v2/oauth/token](https://connect.getvim.com/os-api/v2/oauth/token) moved to [https://api.getvim.com/v1/oauth/token](https://api.getvim.com/v1/oauth/token)
- [https://connect.getvim.com/os-api/v2/oauth/userinfo](https://connect.getvim.com/os-api/v2/oauth/userinfo) moved to [https://api.getvim.com/v1/oauth/userinfo](https://api.getvim.com/v1/oauth/userinfo)

While the previous endpoints at connect.getvim.com will remain active for now, we recommend migrating to api.getvim.com for improved performance and reliability.

#### Added read capabilities for SOAP fields new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-read-capabilities-for-soap-fields)

All SOAP fields (Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan) are now accessible for reading. This structured clinical documentation data in the encounter state enables developers to build solutions that streamline and enhance clinical workflows. Developers can now leverage the free text data within these fields to extract insightful information, enriching their application's business logic with relevant clinical context and improving decision-making or workflow automation.

For further details, please refer to the [Encounter resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#encounter).

#### Billing information and Procedure codes in writeBack Breaking change [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#billing-information-and-procedure-codes-in-writeback)

The procedureCodes object under encounter has been relocated to a new subsection, billingInformation . This update aligns with SDK writeback destination, where CPT code writebacks are processed in the billing section rather than the plans section

json

```
 {
  ...encounter
  billingInformation: {
    procedureCodes: [...]
  },
  plan: {
    generalNotes: ''
  }
 }
```

For further details, please refer to the [Update encounter documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#encounter-1).

#### Organization Tin typing Breaking change [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#organization-tin-typing)

The tin field type has been updated from `string` to `string[]`, allowing developers to retrieve a complete list of TINs for a Vim organization as an array rather than a single value. This change better reflects scenarios where a single Vim organization may encompass multiple locations, each with its own TIN.

For further details, please refer to the [Organization resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/session-context#organization).

#### Number of visits typing Breaking change [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#number-of-visits-typing)

The numberOfVisits field type has changed from `string` to `number`. This update aligns with EHR limitations, where this field only accepts numeric values, ensuring compatibility and accuracy.

For further details, please refer to the [Referral resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#referral).

## 1.x.x (SDK) / 1.0.6 (npm) - November 26th, 2024 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_1-x-x-sdk-1-0-6-npm-november-26th-2024)

### Added `closeApp` function to enable programmatic app closure new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#added-closeapp-function-to-enable-programmatic-app-closure)

Added a new `closeApp` function to the SDK that allows developers to programmatically close the application. When the app is closed using this method, the `appCloseTrigger` sent to [`appOpenStatus` subscriptions](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#subscribe-to-changes) will be set to 'app\_request'.

For further details, please refer to the [Close app documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#close-app).

## 1.x.x (SDK) / 1.0.5 (npm) - November 14th, 2024 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_1-x-x-sdk-1-0-5-npm-november-14th-2024)

### Add roles to user identifiers new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#add-roles-to-user-identifiers)

Added role information to user identifiers to enable role-based customization of the user experience. This enhancement provides more detailed user context and allows for dynamic interface adjustments based on user roles.

For further details, please refer to the [Organization resource documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/session-context#user-and-organization-data).

## 1.x.x (SDK) / 1.0.4 (npm) - September 25th, 2024 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_1-x-x-sdk-1-0-4-npm-september-25th-2024)

### Add the ability to pass access token to initializeVimSDK function new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#add-the-ability-to-pass-access-token-to-initializevimsdk-function)

As part of the implementation of social login in the authentication flow implementation, you can now pass accessToken to the `initializeVimSDK` function.

This token is required for the SDK initialization to make authenticated requests to Vim's API

For further details, please refer to the [Auth0 social login documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/authentication#auth0-social-login-integration).

## 1.x.x (SDK) / 1.0.3 (npm) - September 16th, 2024 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_1-x-x-sdk-1-0-3-npm-september-16th-2024)

### Add subscriptions for changes in updatable fields new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#add-subscriptions-for-changes-in-updatable-fields)

To enable your application to respond in real-time to changes in writeback capabilities, which ensures a seamless and responsive user experience, you can now subscribe to events that notify you whenever the availability of specific fields for writeback changes.

For further details, please refer to the [Subscribe to changes in the canUpdate state documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#subscribe-to-changes-in-the-canupdate-state).

## 1.x.x (SDK) / 1.0.2 (npm) - August 25nd, 2024 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_1-x-x-sdk-1-0-2-npm-august-25nd-2024)

### Expose `vimOS.sessionContext.getIdToken()` method new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#expose-vimos-sessioncontext-getidtoken-method)

To enable optional Single Sign-On (SSO) functionality within your application, the vimOS.sessionContext.getIdToken() method has been exposed. This method allows your application to access the ID token, which is crucial for integrating with SSO flows.

For further details, please refer to the [Optional - application SSO documentation](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/authentication#optional-application-sso).

## 1.x.x (SDK) / 1.0.1 (npm) - August 22nd, 2024 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_1-x-x-sdk-1-0-1-npm-august-22nd-2024)

### Make `appTokenEndpoint` parameter in SDK initialization options optional: The SDK will now use the token endpoint defined in the manifest if the parameter is not provided. new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#make-apptokenendpoint-parameter-in-sdk-initialization-options-optional-the-sdk-will-now-use-the-token-endpoint-defined-in-the-manifest-if-the-parameter-is-not-provided)

Instead of the previously suggested initialization method, we recommend using the following approach that will derive the token endpoint from the manifest definition:

script tagnpm

ts

```
const vimOS = await window.vimSdk.initializeVimSDK();
// Use VimOS instance for further interactions with VimOS.js
```

ts

```
import { loadSdk } from 'vim-os-js-browser';

async function init() {
  const vimOS = await loadSdk();
  // Use vimOS instance for further interactions with VimOS.js
}
init();
```

## 1.x.x (SDK) / 1.0.0 (npm) - August 1st, 2024 [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#_1-x-x-sdk-1-0-0-npm-august-1st-2024)

### Know why your application was open / closed new feature [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#know-why-your-application-was-open-closed)

We have upgraded the functionality of [subscribing to changes in the app state](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#subscribe-to-changes). If you subscribe to `appOpenStatus`, whenever you application open status changes you will receive not only what the new status is, but also what triggered the change.

ts

```
interface AppOpenStatus {
  isAppOpen: boolean;
  appOpenTrigger?: 'manually' | 'auto_popup' | 'push_notification_clicked';
  appCloseTrigger?: 'manually' | 'app_switch' | 'app_disabled';
}
```

### Session context data reorganization breaking change [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#session-context-data-reorganization)

The [Session context](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js//session-context) data is now organized under sub entities, with each sub entity connection to permissions to be set under app version manifest.

![session permissions](https://docs.getvim.com/images/permissions/session.png)

### EHR resources reorganization breaking change [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#ehr-resources-reorganization)

EHR resources, both for [reading](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#read-ehr-resources) and for [writebacks](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#writeback-to-ehr-resources), are now organized under sub entities, with each sub entity connected to a permission to be set under app version manifest.

![resource permissions](https://docs.getvim.com/images/resource_permissions.001.jpeg)

### Replacement of Enum types with string type breaking change [​](https://docs.getvim.com/change-log/\#replacement-of-enum-types-with-string-type)

We are moving away from using enums in our type system; Types that where defined as enums in pervious versions are now simple strings instead:

- The `ActivationStatus` in the [setActivationStatus](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#activation-status) function.
- The `ApplicationSize` in the [setDynamicAppSize](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#dynamic-app-size) function.
- The EHR resource types, such as [when subscribing to ehr state changes](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#subscribe-to-ehr-resources)
  - For example, if you were using `vimOS.ehr.subscribe(EHR.EHRResource.patient, onPatientChange)` to subscribe to patient changes, you should change it to `vimOS.ehr.subscribe('patient', onPatientChange)`.
- The `status` and `priority` of [a referral](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js//vim-ehr-connectivity#referral).
- The `status` of [an encounter](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js//vim-ehr-connectivity#encounter).
- The `type` of [an order](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-ehr-connectivity#orders)
- The `buttonStyle` in [push notifications](https://docs.getvim.com/vim-os-js/vim-hub#show-push-notification).
